exposure: gestational age categories (extremely preterm: <28 weeks, very preterm: 28-32 weeks, late preterm: 32-36 weeks)
cohort: 350 women who delivered preterm babies at a tertiary care hospital between January 2018 and December 2022.
finding: Preterm birth, especially at earlier gestational ages, is associated with significantly higher rates of both neonatal and maternal complications.
followup_time: Immediate postnatal period during hospital stay
gest_age: Preterm (<37 weeks), categorized into extremely preterm (<28 weeks), very preterm (28-32 weeks), and late preterm (32-36 weeks).
